title: Tool use
description: The harness's TOOL_USE record: one use of either read-only tool, the docs lookup or the history call (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §8.1, §8.4, §12, §16.5; the Director's ruling on U19, 26 October 2026). The tools are named docs_lookup and history, the names the model calls them by. GET /history?points= lists its points comma-separated, as in GET /history?points=EPS_BATT_V,EPS_BATT_SOC&window_s=900. The arguments are recorded as parsed values.

tool.description: Which tool was used, by the name the model calls it.

arguments.description: What the tool was given, as parsed values.

result_sha256.description: The hash of the reply's canonical JSON (§4).

points.description: GET /history's points, parsed from its comma-separated list.
